name: In Search of Anthion
label: Quest
description: In Search of Anthion: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Well, nothing left for us to do but try out the goblin's invention. Word has it that Anthion was mowed down by the undead legions of Stratholme as he tried to enter its gates.
Try using the device there and find out whatever Anthion knew.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Deliana had you contact me? I'll do my best to help you, but first I must ask a great favor of you.
